enhanced.what: baseline: the plugin's default enhanced run (its export fix-ups, keepouts, Board Setup minimums and --kicad-dru as the plugin passes them at the run commit), one routing pass and rip-up start cost 1500 for time (as N05-pin-escape); no pin escape

It did: `-mp 1 --router.scoring.start_ripup_costs=1500` are there 'for time (as Q21.4)', with 'the optimizer, more passes or the plugin's full default (-mp unset)' not registered 'for time', under the same 120 s / 600 s limits this registration keeps. boards.why: Paths are relative to the main checkout's root, under target/ (not in git); the copies were made 2026-10-20 into target/orchestrator/n05pe2/boards/ (cp -r of each project folder, `diff -r` against its source printed nothing), and a missing copy is re-made from the row's source and must hash as registered. The seven N05 rows hash as docs/roadmap/prereg/N05-pin-escape.json's boards.files; vna-usb-pd hashes as docs/roadmap/prereg/Q22.json's. Every row is routed whole (grade.sh strips the board's tracks and vias, no --keep-tracks), as N05-pin-escape graded. rules_files pins the .kicad_pro and .kicad_dru each grade reads (rules = project on every row)

grading: every route inside tools/kicad-oracle/grade.sh --export plugin of Q/eng (the plugin's export and DSN fix-ups, the router flags it passes with the Board Setup minimums and --kicad-dru, its SES import; kicad-cli pcb drc --severity-all --refill-zones of the stripped and the routed board under the project's own .kicad_pro/.kicad_dru with the copper classes forced to error; Q22.2's copper basis); then tools/kicad-oracle/via_in_pad.py of Q/eng with KiCad's python3 -I on OUT/ARM/ROW/routed/BASE.kicad_pcb and OUT/ARM/ROW/unrouted/BASE.kicad_pcb. One KiCad grade per distinct session: each arm and row is one grade.sh call; when a row's two sessions (OUT/ARM/ROW/work/BASE.ses) are byte-identical, enhanced's grade is used for both and the candidate's is discarded unread. Row by row in set order, enhanced first; one route and one kicad-cli at a time (start a grade.sh call only while `pgrep -x kicad-cli` shows none)
limits: ulimit -v 8000000 on every grade.sh call (route included); timeout -k 10 on the whole call, 600 s for canary-pwr and 120 s for every other row, the same in both arms (decided 2026-10-20). A call that hits its limit (exit status 124 or above) is recorded as aborted = 1 and TIMEOUT, is not graded and is not rerun; an arm with an aborted route is not accepted. Routing time in the worst case: 2 x (9 x 120 + 600) s = 56 min; N05-pin-escape's 14 routes of the seven rows took at most 79.5 s each

metric_definitions.via_in_pad: via_in_pad.py's vias_in_pads on the routed board minus the stripped (unrouted) board's, floored at 0; a hard metric, absolute in each arm (D8: a via in a pad is a failure)
metric_definitions.below_minimum: routed tracks and vias, those whose nanometre copper key (oracle_lib.copper_key over oracle_lib.read_copper of OUT/ARM/ROW/routed/BASE.kicad_pcb) the stripped board (OUT/ARM/ROW/unrouted/BASE.kicad_pcb, oracle_lib.input_copper_keys) does not have, strictly below the Board Setup minimum track width, via diameter or via drill (OUT/ARM/ROW/routed/copper.json board_minimums_mm), summed: Q22.2's copper basis as docs/roadmap/prereg/Q22.json defines it; absolute in each arm
metric_definitions.manufacturing_breaches: the sum over clearance, hole_clearance, hole_to_hole, copper_edge_clearance, track_width, via_diameter, annular_width, drill_out_of_range, solder_mask_bridge, shorting_items of summary drc_real_by_type: the routing-caused KiCad DRC items on the copper basis (summary routing_caused_basis = copper; Q22.2: an item is routing-caused when it involves a track or via the input board does not have at the same nanometre coordinates, width, layer and net), the ten types as docs/roadmap/prereg/Q22.json defines them; absolute in each arm. A row whose summary says routing_caused_basis = report is unjudged
metric_definitions.kicad_unconnected: summary unconnected_items: kicad-cli's unconnected items on the routed board
metric_definitions.unrouted: the router's final unrouted count (OUT/ARM/ROW/work/engine.log's last `final score: ... (N unrouted`), reported
metric_definitions.connections: pad-to-pad connections of the board as counted in boards.rows
metric_definitions.routing_caused_by_type: summary drc_real_by_type, every type (via_dangling, track_dangling, starved_thermal and the rest included)
metric_definitions.drc_real: summary drc_real, the sum of routing_caused_by_type
metric_definitions.input_unconnected: summary input_unconnected_items: kicad-cli's unconnected items on the stripped board
metric_definitions.route_seconds: summary engine_seconds: the engine command's wall time
metric_definitions.aborted: 1 when the grade.sh call hit its ulimit -v 8000000 or its timeout (exit status 124 or above, or summary engine_exit >= 124), else 0
metric_definitions.below_minimum_all: the sum of summary copper.below_minimum track_width + via_diameter + via_drill (every track and via on the routed board below the Board Setup minimums); on these stripped rows it should equal below_minimum, reported to show that
metric_definitions.via_in_pad_raw: via_in_pad.py's vias_in_pads on the routed board

guards: Absolute, decided 2026-10-20 (docs/roadmap/routing-quality.md, order of importance item 1, and N05.3's re-registration decision): in EACH arm, on every row, manufacturing_breaches = 0 (the routing-caused clearance, hole_clearance, hole_to_hole, copper_edge_clearance, track_width, via_diameter, annular_width, drill_out_of_range, solder_mask_bridge, shorting_items on the copper basis, as Q22.json defines them), below_minimum = 0 and via_in_pad = 0. This replaces N05-pin-escape's 'arm minus baseline, floored at 0'. A metric that skips the rules the DSN lacks is not used: item 1 counts every board rule. A row where plain enhanced breaks a guard is a blocking row: the breach is the baseline's bug to fix, and the promotion waits for that fix
keep_rule: N02's totals rule with accept no-regress, N05's form, plus the absolute guard in both arms: promote only if (1) every row is graded in both arms on the copper basis (no aborted route, no ungraded row); (2) the guards hold in both arms on every row (manufacturing_breaches, below_minimum and via_in_pad 0 in enhanced and in enhanced+pin_escape); (3) `freerouting-dev gate --prereg` passes on the verdict pair (0 refusals; every hard metric 0; the kicad_unconnected total not worse than enhanced's by more than the set's noise; no board worse than twice its band); and (4) the candidate's kicad_unconnected total is lower than enhanced's (change < 0; the stage exists to win connections back, so a tie does not promote it). Then router.fanout.pin_escape = straight joins ENHANCED. Otherwise the option stays off in both profiles and the verdict, with the clause that failed, goes in N05.3. The plugin's checkbox and the CLI key stay either way
keep_rule_by_hand: The gate's totals verdict judges the candidate's hard metrics only, so N05.3 applies clause (2) for enhanced from the reported pair: (a) records.json carries per row and arm the metrics above from OUT/ARM/ROW/summary.json, via_in_pad.json and the copper computation, the input sha256 and the arms block as registered; (b) `freerouting-dev gate --records records.json --baseline baseline.json --prereg docs/roadmap/prereg/N05-pin-escape-2.json --write-baseline`, then `freerouting-dev gate --records records.json --prereg docs/roadmap/prereg/N05-pin-escape-2.json --all-pairs`; both must report 0 refusals; (c) the verdict pair's HARD lines are candidate breaches and reject; the reported pair's HARD lines are enhanced's breaches, each a blocking row (verdict 'blocked by the baseline', the rows and items named: DRC type, the items KiCad names, the rule and the actual distance), and the promotion waits; any UNGRADED or aborted row gives 'not established on the full set', the rows named; (d) otherwise the totals verdict and clause (4) decide
report: per row and arm: kicad_unconnected and input_unconnected; unrouted; routing_caused_by_type (every type), manufacturing_breaches, below_minimum, below_minimum_all, via_in_pad and via_in_pad_raw; vias; route_seconds and aborted; the stubs pin escape laid per part (the router log); the session sha256 and whether the row's two sessions are byte-identical; per row the change in kicad_unconnected (candidate - enhanced) against its band, and the totals per arm against the set noise
stop_rule: one registered run per arm per row; no reruns with other settings; a timed-out route is recorded (aborted = 1) and not rerun. A change after the first number goes in `amendments` with its reason
seen_before_registration: N05-pin-escape (main 980fd6a, these arms and flags, its relative guard) routed the seven N05 rows in both arms: KiCad unconnected off -> straight mydevboard 57 -> 55, canary-pwr 52 -> 51, vfo-controller 13 -> 11, flight-computer 6 -> 7, ch32v003 17 -> 15, solarmeshtastic 1 -> 1, cc1101 10 -> 7 (total 156 -> 147); manufacturing breaches 0 in both arms on every row but ch32v003 (30 / 32, its .kicad_dru custom rules, the Q22 class that Q22.14/Q22.15 brought to the router). Q21.4 routed mydevboard and canary-pwr with pin escape at older engines. The three new rows were never routed with pin_escape = straight: vna-usb-pd, picodvi and openmuscle have numbers only from other registrations and setups (Q07 and N04.3 for vna-usb-pd and openmuscle, vna-usb-pd also a Q22.7 row; Q07 and X07-X09 for picodvi), none with these arms, flags and grader. Q22.8 (docs/roadmap/prereg/Q22.json) routes the projects mydevboard, ch32v003, flight-computer and vna-usb-pd, and canary-pwr at ab786fcc (a different board), with the plugin's full defaults and --keep-tracks before this runs. The implementer routed and graded nothing for this registration; the connection counts were read with pcbnew from the files hashed here
not_registered: pin_escape as anything but straight (it has no other value)
the optimizer, more passes or the plugin's full default (-mp unset), for time (options.flags_why)
N05-pin-escape's relative guard (arm minus baseline, floored at 0)

eligible boards over 310 connections or past the three smallest new ones (boards.eligibility lists them), and eligible boards whose only qualifying parts have fewer than 10 side pins or a pitch over 0.5 mm (laser-backplane-dvi-laserbackplane-dvi 98 connections: RN1 and U1, 8 pins at 0.65 mm; microzed-carrier-board 450)
KiCad 4/5 boards (target/corpus-d3c), the bare export, the kicad_pcb board input and --keep-tracks
Windows KiCad 10.0.5 and running inside the KiCad editor

decision_table.accepted: N05 adds fanout.pin_escape = "straight" to ENHANCED (settings/profile.rs) with this measurement, a DIVERGENCES 'Profile enhanced' line, the profile test and a line under archived Q21
decision_table.rejected: the option stays off in both profiles; the verdict and the failed clause go in N05.3
decision_table.blocked by the baseline: plain enhanced breaks a guard on a row: N05.3 records each row and item; the breach becomes an item of the checklist that owns its cause; the promotion waits for that fix and a new registration
decision_table.not established on the full set: N05.3 stays partial, naming the unjudged rows and why
